name: momo-video
description: Generate videos through the local MOMO API Proxy with dynamic model capabilities and remote output URLs.

interface.longDescription: A Codex plugin for text-to-video and image-to-video tasks through the locally configured MOMO API Proxy. It discovers exact model parameters from the authenticated gateway and returns remote output URLs without downloading large video files by default.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use MOMO Video for video generation. Check video_capabilities before selecting model-specific parameters, submit with video_generate, and poll with video_task_status. Do not download the completed video unless the user explicitly asks.
